queries.query: Which cathode coatings reduced capacity fade in NMC811 cells cycled at 45 C since 2022, and by how much?

args.query: NMC811 cathode coating capacity fade 45 C since 2022

docs.text: 2023 cell study. Al2O3 ALD coating on NMC811 cathodes cycled at 45 C. Capacity fade after 500 cycles fell from 18% to 11%.
2022 cell study. LiNbO3 coating on NMC811 cathodes cycled at 45 C. Capacity fade after 500 cycles fell from 17% to 13%.
2019 cell study. Al2O3 coating on NMC622 cathodes cycled at 25 C. Capacity fade after 300 cycles fell from 9% to 7%.

steps.text: Two coatings qualify. Al2O3 ALD cut NMC811 capacity fade after 500 cycles at 45 C from 18% to 11% [RPT-0412], and LiNbO3 cut it from 17% to 13% [RPT-0388].
